This is the first meeting of any kind between these teams since a two-legged League Cup clash in the 1989/90 season, and the first in the league since both clubs plied their trade in the bottom tier in 1986/87 when it was known as Division 4.

Fulham v Bournemouth (Kick-off 2.05pm). Coverage of the top-flight match from Craven Cottage.
